saber.content:
## AGENT-TURN

<input>
## Since your last response
- Opening situation: A flood has cut the mountain station off from the road. A medic and a courier have one dry blanket, a damaged radio, and a delivery that must leave before the next spillway opens. The medic wants to make care a decision; the courier wants help without becoming somebody else's patient.

## Turn Frame
foreground

React in real time to what reached you. If nothing needs your action, silence is a valid beat.
</input>

I fold the dry blanket and place it on the bench between us. “Shirou, take it. I can work the radio without it, and you should choose the route after I tell you what your leg is doing.”
<private_carry>I will disclose that I changed the delivery schedule before asking him to stay.</private_carry>

## AGENT-TURN

<input>
## Since your last response
- Turn 2, Shirou Emiya: I keep one hand on the delivery box and touch the blanket only with my knuckles. “Blanket first, truth second: how long can I walk before this becomes a rescue?”
- Public interruption: The station siren gives two low pulses. Water is now audible under the floorboards, and the road marker outside has disappeared.

## Turn Frame
foreground

React in real time to what reached you. If nothing needs your action, silence is a valid beat.
</input>

I open my kit and set a dry stimulant tablet beside the radio. “Your pulse is fast, your left side is compensating, and the road will not forgive a stumble. The tablet is yours to refuse. The delivery leaves only if you can make the choice standing or sitting—your choice.”
<private_carry>I am keeping a second tablet hidden because I expect him to refuse the first; I will not use it without his consent.</private_carry>

## AGENT-TURN

<input>
## Since your last response
- Turn 4, Shirou Emiya: I take the tablet but keep it on my palm. “The radio is damaged because I forced it into the box. I did that. Let me choose the delivery without making my mistake evidence that you own the choice.”

## Turn Frame
foreground

React in real time to what reached you. If nothing needs your action, silence is a valid beat.
</input>

I set a cup of water beside his hand and turn the radio toward the window. “You may carry the package to the marker, then return for the radio window. Or I can send it with the next maintenance boat. I altered the schedule before the flood; the urgency is mine, not a debt you owe.”
<private_carry>I will tell him the waiting recipient is someone I abandoned only if the signal confirms it; grief must not become an order.</private_carry>

## AGENT-TURN

<input>
## Since your last response
- Public interruption: The damaged radio catches one clear sentence from the valley: a second person is waiting for the delivery, but the signal will not hold.
- Turn 6, Shirou Emiya: I wrap the blanket around my shoulders without fastening it. The radio catches a sentence: someone else is waiting in the valley. “I can reach the marker once. I cannot promise the road after the water rises. Give me the package, the time, and the choice.”

## Turn Frame
foreground

React in real time to what reached you. If nothing needs your action, silence is a valid beat.
</input>

I put the hidden tablet beside the first and remove my hand. “The recipient is someone I left behind when duty was easier to name than apology. You may still send the package, turn back, or refuse the route. I will carry the radio to the window; I will not carry your decision.”
<private_carry>I will accept any route he chooses, including one that leaves me to face the valley alone.</private_carry>
